title: XIV–XVI. Priestly office: preparation and function of the high priest
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Through sufferings He was consecrated to ye priestly and kingly munus. — 10:21), ye Lamb belonging toward God (John 1:36), our Passover (1 Corinthians 5:7), and advocate (1 John 2:1). — 5:6; — 4:14; — Our Christ stands as high priest (Hebrews 2:11; — The function belonging toward ye munus consists both in ye oblation belonging toward ye sacrifice toward sins and in intercession with ye Father. — XVI. — Preparation stands as that same which belonging toward ye priests vocation and consecration, by which ye Son belonging toward God stands as destined and anointed to ye priestly munus. — XV. — In ye priesthood belonging toward Christ stand as considered preparation and function. — XIV. — Latin anchors: sacerdotio, Christi, considerantur, praeparatio, functio, Preparatio, sacerdotis, vocationis, consecrationis, Filius, munus, sacerdotale, destinatur, ungitur, Functio, muneris, consistit, oblatione, sacrificii, peccatis
pass_b_english: XIV. In the priesthood of Christ are considered preparation and function. XV. Preparation is that of the priests vocation and consecration, by which the Son of God is destined and anointed to the priestly munus.

XVI. The function of the munus consists both in the oblation of the sacrifice for sins and in intercession with the Father. Our Christ is high priest (Hebrews 2:11; 4:14; 5:6; 10:21), the Lamb of God (John 1:36), our Passover (1 Corinthians 5:7), and advocate (1 John 2:1). Through sufferings He was consecrated to the priestly and kingly munus.
source_text: XIV. In sacerdotio Christi considerantur praeparatio & functio. XV. Preparatio est sacerdotis is vocationis & consecrationis, qua Filius Dei ad munus sacerdotale destinatur & ungitur. XVI. Functio muneris consistit tum in oblatione sacrificii pro peccatis, tum in intercessione apud Patrem. Christus noster Heb. 2:11 & 4:14 summus sacerdos, Heb. 5:6 & 10:21, agnus Dei Ioh. 1:36, pascha nostrum 1 Cor. 5:7, advocatus 1 Ioh. 2:1. Per passiones ad sacerdotale & regium munus consecratus est.
